text.en:
Section thirty-six of Presidential Decree Numbered Seven hundred five is amended by adding
another paragraph after paragraph (h) to read as follows:
"In addition to the incentives under this section, private landowners who engage in tree farming on areas fifty
hectares or below by planting their lands with Ipil-Ipil and other fast-growing trees shall be exempt from the
inventory requirement and other requirements before harvest as provided in this Decree for lessees of forest
lands of the public domain: Provided, That the transport of trees cut shall be accompanied by the
corresponding certificate of origin duly issued by the authorized forest officer."
